title: $L^2$-Stability for STFT phase retrieval
summary: We prove that the short-time Fourier transform with Gaussian window performs $L^2$-local stable phase retrieval at the constant function. The proof involved significant interplay between mathematicians and LLMs. An autoformalization in Lean 4 of an extension of our result to $L^2$-local stable phase retrieval for all Hermite windows and all elements in the finite span of the canonical basis vectors is also presented.
